answer: An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the gale check immediately, the lagoon audit keeps the resolved set and the mirror replay exposes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 160 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 160 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
